iceBreaker.heading: 🧊🔨 Ice Breaker
iceBreaker.question: What are Daniel and Eugenia's love languages for both giving and receiving love?

items.text: Brotherly friendship between two friends Daniel and Eugenia, as they spend Monday nights playing basketball together
Romantic love between Daniel and Eugenia as we celebrate tonight as they are united in marriage
Familial love shared among family members: Daniel, Justin, Jannie, Diane, Joshua, and Eugenia, Wilson, Jackie, Marco, and Mackenzie
The unconditional, selfless, sacrificial love of God. The love Daniel and Eugenia share for everyone here tonight is a reflection of God's unconditional love for them first.

scripture.heading: 📖 1 John 4:10-12, 19
scripture.text:
This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins. Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another. No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us. …
We love because he first loved us.

insight.heading: 💭 Some Insight
items: Love didn't begin with us, it began with God

The greatest demonstration of God's love is that, while we were still sinners, God sent His one and only son, Jesus Christ, to die on the cross as an atoning sacrifice for our sins. Through believing in Jesus, we can receive forgiveness, new life, and the hope of eternal life with God.

The 4 biblical expressions of love are woven in Daniel and Eugenia's love story, from friendship, to romance, to family. But above all, their love points to God's Agape unconditional and sacrificial love. "We love because He first loved us."

discussion.heading: 🗣️ Discussion (pick either or)
questions: When you hear that God loves you unconditionally and sent Jesus to die for you, what thoughts, feelings, or questions come to mind?
What is one way someone has shown you unconditional love? How did it impact you?

iceBreaker.heading: 🧊🔨 破冰
iceBreaker.question: 你觉得 Daniel 和 Eugenia 彼此表达爱与接受爱的方式（爱之语）是什么？

items.text: 友谊之爱——Daniel 与 Eugenia 之间深厚的友谊，源自他们每周一晚上一起打篮球的相处时光。
爱情之爱——Daniel 与 Eugenia 之间的浪漫爱情，今夜我们一同庆祝他们步入婚姻。
亲情之爱——家人之间自然流露的亲情，象征 Daniel 与 Eugenia 两个家庭彼此连接：Daniel, Justin, Jannie, Diane, Joshua, and Eugenia, Wilson, Jackie, Marco, and Mackenzie
上帝的爱——上帝无条件、无私且牺牲的爱。Daniel 与 Eugenia 对今晚在场每一位的爱，是源于上帝先向他们所显明的爱。

scripture.heading: 📖 约翰一书 4:10-12, 19
scripture.text:
不是我们爱神，乃是神爱我们，差祂的儿子为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。亲爱的弟兄啊，神既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。从来没有人见过神，我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，爱祂的心在我们里面得以完全了。…
我们爱，因为神先爱我们。

insight.heading: 💭 小分享
items: 爱并不是由我们开始，而是神先爱了我们。
神爱我们最大的证明，就是当我们仍在罪中的时候，祂差遣祂独生的儿子耶稣基督，为我们的罪死在十字架上，使我们能与神和好。借着相信耶稣，我们可以得着赦免、新生命，以及与神永远同在的盼望。
圣经中的四种爱贯穿 Daniel 与 Eugenia 的爱情故事中，从友谊、爱情，到家庭。但最重要的是，他们的故事指向神那无条件且牺牲的爱。「我们爱，因为神先爱我们。」

discussion.heading: 🗣️ 讨论（任选其一）
questions: 当你听见神无条件地爱你，并差遣耶稣为你的缘故死在十字架上时，你有什么想法、感受或疑问？
有没有一个人曾经向你展现过无条件的爱？这份爱如何影响了你？
